# EcoPower Suite

> Intelligent Windows energy optimization, multi-monitor dimming and power management utility. Free, ad-free, closed-source (proprietary).

## Project Summary
EcoPower Suite is a lightweight, standalone Windows utility (Windows 10 & 11, 64-bit, single .exe, no installer) designed to reduce idle PC electricity consumption by up to 40% (simulated estimate) and extend laptop battery life. It runs locally with no telemetry, no accounts and no adware. The only network activity is an optional, user-initiated update check and download from GitHub (api.github.com / github.com releases); in v1.1.0 the automatic update check is opt-in and off by default.

- Latest version: v1.1.0 (2026-11-11)
- Website: https://bambadooma-star.github.io/ecopower-suite-app/
- Download: https://github.com/bambadooma-star/ecopower-suite-app/releases/download/v1.1.0/EcoPowerSuite.exe
- Mirror: https://bambadooma-star.github.io/ecopower-suite-app/downloads/EcoPowerSuite.exe
- License: free to use; proprietary, closed-source; supported by voluntary donations.

## Key Capabilities
- **Three power modes**: Eco Saver (CPU capped, screen dimmed, PCIe ASPM max savings), Balanced (everyday default), Max Performance (full turbo).
- **Automatic idle saver**: moves to Eco after a configurable idle time (2-60 min) and restores the previous mode on activity.
- **Universal display dimming**: VESA DDC/CI for external monitors (range-scaled per monitor) and WMI for laptop panels, non-blocking.
- **Smart battery balancing**: switches laptops to Balanced once when AC power is disconnected.
- **Smart Inactivity Shield**: pauses idle dimming during fullscreen video, active audio sessions, game-controller input, and AI/bot workloads (Ollama, LM Studio, ComfyUI, llama.cpp, Whisper, NVIDIA CUDA compute above 15% load).
- **Scheduled shutdown**: Windows Task Scheduler integration with a 30-second warning, a real 1-hour snooze, or cancel-for-today.
- **Savings tracker**: kWh and money saved today, year-to-date and projected, using the user's own tariff and currency.

## What's new in v1.1.0
- Redesigned dashboard with sidebar navigation and a live power gauge.
- Smoother, faster UI (background commands no longer block the window); non-blocking brightness control with correct DDC/CI range scaling.
- Fixes: brightness no longer reset to 100% on launch; the electricity tariff setting now applies; true year-to-date savings; shutdown snooze really reschedules; CLI `--status` detects Eco correctly; laptop brightness via CLI works.
- Safer in-app updater (integrity checks) and an opt-in automatic update check.

## CLI & Autonomous Bot Interface
Bots, AI agents and scripts can run headless commands:
- `EcoPowerSuite.exe --status [--json]`: real-time wattage, brightness, battery and shield status.
- `EcoPowerSuite.exe --mode <eco|balanced|perf> [--json]`: set the power profile in one shot.
- `EcoPowerSuite.exe --brightness <0-100> [--json]`: set monitor backlight level.
- `EcoPowerSuite.exe --ai-shield [--json]`: query AI and bot workload detection.
- `EcoPowerSuite.exe --check-update [--json]`: check GitHub for a newer release.

## Integrity & Verification
- **Executable**: `EcoPowerSuite.exe` (v1.1.0, 22.2 MB, standalone)
- **SHA-256**: `805A056D580FDACC3A8A9B457F5FD3088C79871735EB0F8510E572201B84033D`
- **Verify (PowerShell)**: `Get-FileHash .\EcoPowerSuite.exe -Algorithm SHA256`
- **VirusTotal lookup by hash**: https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/805A056D580FDACC3A8A9B457F5FD3088C79871735EB0F8510E572201B84033D
- Windows SmartScreen may show "Unknown publisher" for a new, unsigned free utility: choose "More info" then "Run anyway" after verifying the hash.
